mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON ( iaad.cmdb_id, TRIM(iaad.user_it_code)::citext, COALESCE(TRIM(iaad.user_id), ''), COALESCE(TRIM(iaad.system_role_id), ''), TRIM(iaad.system_role) ) iaad.cmdb_id, iaad.application_name AS app_name, TRIM(iaad.user_it_code)::citext AS user_it_code, TRIM(iaad.user_id) AS user_id, TRIM(iaad.system_role_id) AS system_role_id, TRIM(iaad.system_role) AS system_role, iaad.role_description FROM its_application_access_data iaad INNER JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 upp ON LOWER(TRIM(upp.user_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(iaad.user_it_code)) WHERE UPPER(TRIM(upp.coc_flag)) = 'Y' AND LOWER(TRIM(iaad.access_label)) = 'sensitive' AND NULLIF(TRIM(iaad.cmdb_id), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(iaad.user_it_code), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(iaad.system_role), '') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY iaad.cmdb_id, TRIM(iaad.user_it_code)::citext, COALESCE(TRIM(iaad.user_id), ''), COALESCE(TRIM(iaad.system_role_id), ''), TRIM(iaad.system_role), iaad.id
mapper.insert:
WITH current_violations AS (
) INSERT INTO na_sensitive_access_alert ( cmdb_id, app_name, user_it_code, user_id, user_coc_type, system_role_id, system_role, role_description, role_classification, alert_status, alert_trigger_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) SELECT current.cmdb_id, current.app_name, current.user_it_code, current.user_id, 'Y', current.system_role_id, current.system_role, current.role_description, 'sensitive', 'Pending', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{operator}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM current_violations current WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM na_sensitive_access_alert alert WHERE alert.cmdb_id = current.cmdb_id AND alert.user_it_code = current.user_it_code AND alert.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current.user_id AND alert.system_role_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current.system_role_id AND alert.system_role = current.system_role AND alert.alert_status IN ('Pending', 'Suppressed') ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update:

) UPDATE na_sensitive_access_alert alert SET alert_status = 'Resolved', resolved_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE alert.alert_status = 'Pending' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM current_violations current WHERE alert.cmdb_id = current.cmdb_id AND alert.user_it_code = current.user_it_code AND alert.user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current.user_id AND alert.system_role_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current.system_role_id AND alert.system_role = current.system_role )
